visual.name: bfusionResourceAlignmentStrategy
visual.description: Bubble/scatter chart plotting initiatives by Resource Demand (FTEs) vs. Strategic Alignment Score, with a 'Misaligned Resource Drag' warning quadrant, insights side-panel (toggle on/off), info popover, drill-down, drill-through, and cross-filtering.

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Initiative / Plan / Project. Each value becomes one bubble. Supports drill-down hierarchy (e.g. Portfolio > Program > Project).

dataRoles.name: color
dataRoles.description: Categorical field used for bubble color and legend (e.g. Business Unit, Department, Plan Type). Optional.

dataRoles.name: xValue
dataRoles.description: X-axis measure — dedicated FTEs required per initiative (e.g. [ResPlan - Committed FTE] or [Demand] ÷ 1720). Required.

dataRoles.name: yValue
dataRoles.description: Y-axis measure — strategic alignment on a 0–100 scale (or your own scale; the visual auto-rescales). Required.

dataRoles.name: size
dataRoles.description: Optional measure controlling bubble size (e.g. Budget, Headcount). Falls back to FTE if omitted.

dataRoles.name: tooltipFields
dataRoles.description: Additional measures to show in tooltips.

dataRoles.name: drillthrough
dataRoles.description: Fields carried when the user drills through to another page.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model.

showInsights.description: Toggle the insights sidebar on or off.

showSmartInsights.description: Render contextual callouts (misalignment hotspots, concentration, dominance) at the bottom of the panel.

showInfoButton.description: Show the (i) information button in the visual header.

infoText.description: Text shown in the info popover.

showDataLabels.description: Show the FTE number inside each bubble.

showInitiativeLabels.description: Show the initiative name next to each bubble.

showLegend.description: Show the color legend at the top of the chart.

yAxisMax.description: Maximum value for the Strategic Alignment Score axis. Default 100. Leave 0 for auto-scale.

showTopDemand.description: Show a Top-N list of initiatives by FTE Demand (with data bars) in the insights panel.

topDemandCount.description: How many initiatives to include in the Top FTE Demand list (1–50).

showPareto.description: Show a Pareto chart of FTE consumption (bars + cumulative %) in the insights panel.

showReclamation.description: Show a what-if slider in the insights panel that recovers a percentage of misaligned FTE. Misaligned bubbles shrink in the chart as the slider moves.

reclamationPct.description: Persisted reclamation slider position (0–100). The slider in the visual updates this value when released.

showZone.description: Display the red dashed quadrant highlighting high-demand low-alignment initiatives.

showZoneLabel.description: Display the 'Misaligned Resource Drag' label inside the zone.

fteThreshold.description: Initiatives with FTE demand at or above this value count as 'high demand'.

alignmentThreshold.description: Initiatives with Strategic Alignment Score at or below this value count as 'low alignment'.

zoneOpacity.description: Fill opacity of the warning zone (0–100).

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
